overview_description.description: Apex designs and manufactures small satellites tailored for various space missions. The company focuses on streamlining satellite production by integrating modular hardware and standardized software systems. Apex offers platforms that support Earth observation, communications, and scientific research applications. Its approach emphasizes scalable manufacturing processes to meet the growing demand for satellite deployment. Apex collaborates with clients to customize satellite configurations based on mission-specific requirements.

about_short_description.short_description: Apex designs and manufactures satellite buses tailored for various space missions.

product.name: Aries
product.description: A configurable satellite bus family for LEO and GEO missions, supporting payloads up to 150 kg in LEO and up to 120 kg in a standard GEO ESPA configuration.

product.name: Nova
product.description: An adaptable LEO satellite bus for demanding constellation missions, supporting payloads up to 300 kg with approximately 1 kW of end-of-life payload orbit-average power.

product.name: Comet
product.description: A high-power satellite bus family for large payloads and heavy-launch missions, with announced configurations supporting payloads up to 3,000 kg and payload peak power of 20 kW.

product.name: End-to-End Mission Services
product.description: Mission execution services covering spacecraft analysis, payload integration, environmental testing, launch procurement and integration, commissioning, ground-segment implementation, and mission operations.

product.name: Factory X
product.description: A scalable manufacturing system that helps partners establish local, high-rate production of Apex satellite buses using standardized facilities, processes, training, and production software.
